prompt:
Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp F level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "💻 Orientarsi nell'ambiente digitale", solid fill #006064, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:
  • INNESCA [#5E35B1]: "Orientarsi nell'ambiente digitale"
  • ESPLORA [#1565C0]: "Lo studente sa orientarsi nell'ambiente digitale…" | "cartelle" | "file" | "applicazioni"
  • SPERIMENTA [#E65100]: "hardware / hardware" | "software / software"
  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Smonta virtualmente un vecchio dispositivo" | "cerca le foto di disassemblaggio del tuo modello…" | "Professione futura: Digital Literacy Educator"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "hardware" | "software" | "sistema operativo" | "file"
Style rules: white background, all labels in Italian, branch nodes solid fill (branch color) with white text, hub accent stripe #006064 on bottom edge only, connecting lines 2px curved matching branch color, no photographs, no decorative frames, no gradients, clean radial balanced layout, Inter/Nunito-style sans-serif typography, WCAG AA contrast, flat vector illustration, 1:1 square.
